newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Pernas in restructuring move.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Pernas in restructuring move.

text.p: Malaysian hotel and property concern Pernas International Holdings Bhd (PIHB) said on Monday it was in a restructuring exercise to transfer the strategic business activities of its subsidiaries and associated companies to the group, the national Bernama news agency reported.

Under the exercise, subsidiaries and associated companies -- including quoted and unquoted investments -- of its subsidiaries will be transferred to the group, the agency quoted a company statement as saying.

The transfers involved 10 subsidiaries and associates of wholly-owned Pernas Mining Sdn Bhd, two from Pernas Securities Sdn Bhd, two from Pernas Trading Sdn Bhd and one from Pernas Hotel Chain Holdings Sdn Bhd.

Separately, PIHB said group cashflow would be enhanced with proceeds from its ongoing restricted offer for sale of up to 56.75 million shares in insurer MNI Holdings Bhd at an issue price of 5.80 ringgit per MNI share on a non-renounceable basis to the shareholders of 52.0 percent plantations subsidiary, Tradewinds (M) Bhd.
Also, Pernas Mining had in January entered into an agreement to dispose its entire 49.0 percent interest in PSD Holdings Bhd to another firm for 158.0 million in cash.
Pernas said it was consistently reviewing its structure and would continue to undertake corporate exercises to benefit its shareholders.
This include Tradewinds' move in appointing a merchant banker to undertake a study on the group's intention to list its plantation subsidiaries.
